Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a composition-driven strain self-organization strategy inspired by nacre's mortar layers, creating periodic tensile-compressive corrugation that absorbs volume strain via cooperative microregional deformation and reversible dislocation evolution. item.title: Coupled Design of Silicon Anodes and Solid-State Electrolytes for High-Performance All-Solid-State Batteries
item.description:

ACS Nano | ⭐ Review
💡 This review uniquely adopts a coupled design perspective, integrating silicon anode engineering with solid-state electrolyte compatibility and interfacial stabilization. Its novelty lies in systematic compatibility mapping linking Si architectures to electrolyte families and addressing chemo-mechanical degradation. Significance includes practical manufacturing guidance (stack pressure, prelithiation) and a roadmap combining multiscale characterization, AI-assisted design, and scalable fabrication for commercially viable high-performance Si-SSBs.
🏷 silicon anode · solid-state electrolyte · all-solid-state battery · interfacial stability · coupled design

item.title: Non‐Fluorinated Electrolytes Enable Long‐Cycling Micron‐Sized Silicon Anodes
item.description:
الکترولیت بدون فلوئور بر پایه LiI/LiBr و مونو‌اترها یک SEI بدون LiF و پلیمری روی آند میکرونی سیلیکون می‌سازد که ظرفیت 92.12٪ را پس از 300 چرخه حفظ می‌کند.
Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a non-fluorinated electrolyte (LiI/LiBr with monoether solvents) forming a LiF-free SEI on µm-Si anodes, unlike conventional LiF-rich designs. This SEI creates binder-like high-molecular-weight polymers that preserve particle integrity and electrical connectivity after pulverization. Significance: enables long cycling (92.12% retention after 300 cycles, >99.95% efficiency) and safer, environmentally friendly µm-Si anodes.
🏷 micron silicon anode · non-fluorinated electrolyte · solid electrolyte interphase · LiF-free SEI · lithium-ion battery
